replies.author: Riilo
replies.body:
Hello,

I’d like to address that AmericanOctopus did not intend on banning you on your other account. You can see the punishment says “seniors please remove this”. He would have contacted the seniors but discord was down. For the actual punishment you can make an appeal if you believe it is false.

replies.author: twopump
replies.body: Hello, on behalf of myself and Riilo, I would like to apologize for banning the 'Thrasilias' (one 'l') account. That was my fault and I am working on getting that removed when possible. As for the ban on 'Thrasillias' (2 'l's) that was because of your excessive rudeness towards Piez and other players. Me banning both account was an accident I am happy to apologize and take blame for, but the ban on the account you were actually one is a fair ban. If you want to dispute the ban on your alt Thrasillias then you very well may do so and Riilo and I will sort it out there.
